Lisa Agueda, who practices law in San Francisco, California, was selected to Rising Stars for 2025. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. Prior to becoming an attorney, she studied at Golden Gate University School of Law. She graduated in 2014. After passing the bar exam, she was admitted to legal practice in 2015.
